name: Motomiya Kinue
source: Current head of the distinguished Motomiya family and president of Motomiya company. Arrogant and cold-hearted perfect woman who is blessed with both social position and a loving family. However, her ideal life was spoiled by the marriage of her beloved daughter and the protagonist, which she unwillingly admitted because of her daughter. She will do everything and will never stop until the most hateful existence is gone from her life forever.
